model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of enterprises, employment, and turnover by industry, construction, trade, and services in 2021. The chart contains seven slices representing these categories, with the largest slice, “Industry,” colored blue and accounting for approximately 61% of the total. The next largest slice, “Construction,” is colored orange and represents approximately 21% of the total. “Trade” is represented by a green slice, approximately 12%, followed by “Other Services” colored yellow, representing approximately 9%. The remaining slices represent “Industry” colored blue, approximately 19%, “Construction” colored orange, approximately 31%, and “Trade” colored green, approximately 33%.  The chart includes a legend identifying the colors associated with each category, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
